decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The application for the maintenance and repair works to Barnes Bridge, as shown on drawing numbers 5030485/CBR/180_007 Issue P2 and Untitled - Location of Compound, received 2 April 2007, by reason of the nature of the repairs and maintenance would be compatible with the scale and form of the original building, would maintain the character and appearance of the Listed Building, would protect the riverside character contribution Barnes Bridge makes, would allow for the improvement of public transport infrastructure, would safeguard the integrity of Metropolitan Open Land, and would not have a negative impact on the protection and sensitive management of Local Nature Reserves.  Therefore the proposed development complies with the relevant London Borough of Hounslow Unitary Development Plan 2003 policies ENV-B.2.5 - Development Affecting the Setting of a Listed Building, ENV-B.2.7 -Alterations to Listed Buildings and Buildings of Local Townscape Character, ENV-W.1.3 - Important Views and Structures in the Thames Policy Area, ENV-N.1.5 - Protection of Metropolitan Open Land, ENV-N.1.8 - Dukes Meadows/Riverside Lands, Chiswick - Site Specific MOL Policies, ENV-N.2.2 - Sites of Regional/Local Nature Conservation, T.2.4 - Public Transport Infrastructure and the Supplementary Planning Guidance.

Condition : 2 - MISC.  There shall be no storage of materials within 16 metres of the River Thames.  This must be suitably marked and protected during development, ideally with fencing erected on the landward side of the buffer zone, and there shall be no access during development within this area.  There shall be no fires, dumping or tracking of machinery within this area.
Condition : 3 - A1A.  The works to which this consent relates, must be begun not later than the expiration of three years beginning with the date of this consent.

Condition : 4 - NSTD.  The maintenance and upgrading shall be consistent with the following approved plan numbers:?	5030485/CBR/180_007 Issue P2?	Unnumbered - 'Location of Compound' Received 2nd April 2007

Condition : 5 - H2.  No work shall start on site without prior written notification of the start to the London Division of the Historic Buildings and Monuments Commission, quoting reference date 24/05/2007
Condition : 6 - H3.  All new works, including works of making good, shall match the original work in both type and dimensions of materials and in detailed execution
Condition : 7 - MISC.  The applicant shall submit details of the final colour scheme for Barnes Bridge to the local planning authority for approval in writing.
description: Repair and maintenance works  to Barnes Bridge including re-painting bridge (details of colour to be submitted at later date), replacement of cast iron parapets on 1849 structure (in port) replacement of defective cross girders and rivets
